brique._comment: Engine-native Matter family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: matter.subscribe
objective.description: Subscribe to matter updates, either locally for brique-mode matters or by delegating to the owning wrapper for wrapper-mode matters.

#root.role: Resolve one matter identifier, select the correct ownership mode, and register or delegate the subscription.

matter_id._comment: Required. Name of the matter to subscribe to within the addressed context.

sub_id._comment: Required. Caller-provided subscription identifier. Used to correlate notifications and to unsubscribe.

target._comment: Optional notification address {context,type,cap,version?}. Defaults to the caller address.

durable._comment: Optional, false by default. Durable subscriptions persist across restart and deliver ordered events at least once until matter.subscription.ack.

substance_mode._comment: Substance mode of the subscribed matter (e.g. brique, wrapper, ext_ref).

effects.subscriptions: A local subscription is kept in memory; durable subscriptions and their pending outbox are also persisted.
effects.wrapper_transport: Wrapper-mode subscriptions are forwarded to the wrapper boundary instead of being stored locally.

transformation_contract.morphing: A matter identifier plus a subscription identifier becomes an explicit subscription registration, either local in brique mode or delegated to the owning wrapper.
invariants: Subscriptions are only supported for matters whose catalog substance mode resolves to brique or wrapper.
Brique-mode subscriptions target the caller unless params.target explicitly supplies a complete address.

Durable delivery is at-least-once, ordered per subscription, and requires matter.subscription.ack using the stable event_id. A pre-commit event marker closes the crash window between a Matter commit and outbox persistence.
Wrapper-mode subscriptions are delegated to the owning wrapper boundary instead of being stored locally.
success: On success, matter.subscribe returns ok=true, the matter_id, the effective sub_id, and the resolved substance_mode.
If sub_id is omitted for a brique-mode subscription, the engine mints one before storing the local subscription.
failure: The capacity fails when matter_id is missing.
The capacity refuses subscription when the matter is absent from the runtime catalog.
The capacity refuses subscription when the matter substance mode is neither brique nor wrapper, or when wrapper delegation cannot reach a running wrapper.
notes: Wrapper-mode subscribe requests pass through the current intention to the wrapper after context rewrite.
Local subscription enumeration is deterministic by sub_id.
